title: Changes statement descriptor behaviors for card payments created with Charges
summary: Changes statement descriptor behaviors for card payments created through /v1/charges. To learn more, see our guide on statement descriptors.
migrationNotes: This change alters how statement descriptors are handled for card payments created through the Charges API, providing more accurate branding for connected accounts and standardize descriptor formatting.
